claim_scope: The actual query whole exposure is recognized at the same supplied source occurrence and embedded injectively, with exact get-readback, explicit offset and strict order, into the existing whole born inventory. The same position map is consumed by the original actual paid/settled successor inventory and full vector query; a Type Settlement is generated for that exact actual query result, and original Cofinal full-word/successor/ledger plus actual/cofinal whole-and-mathematical-next consumers are directly applied.
kind: Occurrence-bound whole-tree realization and finite position producer, with direct actual/vector/finite-query-settlement/Cofinal consumers.
certified_machine_facts: Frozen Coordinates production and all 17 necessary current tracked dependency modules independently pass fresh trust0/warningAsError.

Exact frozen direct gate independently passes fresh trust0/werror without -o in 9.389 seconds; all 18 mouths have exactly the standard three axioms and its log SHA equals the accepted construction log.

A read-only clone containing every frozen gate byte, an extra metadata import and appended run_cmd also independently passes without export. All persistent source/gate declarations including private installed_state are in the audited closure.
Generic production has 546 actual local modules, no domain dependency and no Actual.Cofinal import. No new completed declaration is reachable from production intoBorn.
source_exposure consumes original common_raw_exposure for the same actual supplied occurrence through installed cofaces; inventory_source recognizes the entire original Born inventory.
sourceIndex and intoBorn use Fin.cast only on index-bound equalities induced by those whole tree equalities. Existing right/left/right coordinate maps retain the original source positions.

Private generic cast_get proves the original whole-tree Fin.cast/get identity by equality elimination; cast_value/seeded_value/ordered_value retain the exact original offset. No fieldwise transport or new history is introduced.
intoBorn is injective, reads every original actual Trace value, has the explicit constant source offset, and is StrictMono.
Direct intoActual composes the same intoBorn with original Actual.intoActual; its original actual inr/inl branch map supplies injectivity/get-readback.
indexed_update consumes original Actual.old_coordinate at every mapped source position and returns the original complete InventoryVector updateInventory value.

completed uses explicit installed_state/Calculation.target_state plus original Completion.completed to produce a Settlement in Type for the exact Actual.result state. completed_value reads that same result via original source_value. No terminal or endpoint input is supplied.
The duplicate-value control is universal: distinct source positions remain distinct target positions even when their event values coincide, with those values read back exactly.
Direct consumers apply original Cofinal.complete_word/query_successor_field/source_ledger and both actual/cofinal whole and mathematical-next mouths on the fixed source family/binding.
